answer: Proof of reserved bandwidth is one concrete defense. At registration each agent must hold a scheduled upload slot and stream verifier-issued random blocks for a full window, proving control of real network capacity. Slots overlap, so a farmer wanting an ocean of fake agents must lease that many genuine pipes at once. Credentials sit in a vault bound to the measured path and expire unless re-proven each cycle. Like saffron, priced per scarce strand, bandwidth makes every clone cost real money, turning mass sybils from a free multiplier into an expense problem.
